findings.issue: Directory-level run reports failures: celestial 3 (starIlluminanceAt_property_2, discIlluminance_property_2, ringUnlitIF_property_2), relativity 7 (expm1_property_1, sinhc_property_1, accelerate/doppler/dopplerApparent/cmbSeenTemperature*_property_2). All are auto-generated property tests on modules this PR does not touch (reflect, rings, hyper, optics, blackbody); every per-file run is green and pkg quality attests 0 failed. Probably pre-existing on 0.52.0 but not verified against the base commit.
findings.fix: Run `ailang test .` on origin/main to confirm they fail there too; if so, note it in the PR body (and report upstream). Do not claim `ailang test .` green.

findings.issue: HEALPix is checked against 14 hand-picked oracle rows plus a unit-vector sweep at 1e-14, not the design's 10^4 pixels at 1e-15. The 11,433-pixel healpy agreement (8.2e-15) lives only in the oracle run, not in the test.
findings.fix: Say so in the CHANGELOG, or add a few hundred rows (or a checksum over a pixel stride) to the test.

findings.issue: afterglowTemperature omits fIn and eps (greybody, both cancel by design) while luminance uses fIn; the emitter radiates from one face but T is set from the full KE. Labelled game approximation, energy identity eps*fIn*KE holds, but the T-vs-emittance inconsistency is not stated.
findings.fix: One doc-comment line stating T is the whole-spot greybody temperature and fIn only splits the emitted light.

findings.issue: Examples quote 2,500 kg/m^3 while the population uses 3,300. Labelled 'the package check', so honest, but easy to misread.
findings.fix: Keep the label; consider a 3,300 check row beside it.

findings.issue: AC1 is tested against a refit made on the same 63 rows (median 0.378), so it is in-sample and the 0.40 bound is nearly guaranteed. The refit and the failed reproduction (0.648) are reported openly; that is sound.
q = 3.1 is tuned to maximise the >=1e-13 kg flux under the mass constraint; flux 5.52e-8 is 0.55 of Krueger's 1e-7, so the 'within a factor of 2' check is partly circular. Disclosed.
findings.fix: State in the spec that HB-120 is a fitted, not independent, check.

findings.issue: Takes (aMin, aMax, rhoGrain, ...) instead of the design's GrainDist, avoiding a celestial dependency from relativity. Sound; the spec table already shows the real signature. [release] kind is 'feature', not 'minor' as the design text says; it matches the 0.11.0 convention.

deviations_judged.1_refit: honest and sound; disclosed in spec, CHANGELOG, source table
deviations_judged.3_membership_0.712: honest; sim AC, stated in spec section 6 for Mark; alpha Cen column 17.70 vs 17.6+-0.15 is within error
deviations_judged.5_healpix_tolerance: acceptable (healpy 8.2e-15), but test coverage is thin; see minor finding

verdict: PASS, 86/100. Publish gate conditions (quality no gates, dry-run clean, independent pass) are met; confirm the whole-directory property failures are pre-existing.
